Story

Welcome to "Catch Flex," where the ultimate dance game experience meets cutting-edge technology and the thrill of dance. Transform your living room into a lively dance floor with just a copy of the game on your preferred platform and your iPhone or Android camera - no need for extra, costly equipment like motion cameras or trackers!

"Catch Flex" combines professional choreography with advanced AI motion tracking for an immersive and seamless dancing adventure. Our game is tailored for everyone, from beginners to seasoned dancers, and designed to be enjoyable at any skill level. Follow our virtual dance coach's moves, track your scores, and immerse yourself in a blend of entertainment and fitness.

Your body is your controller in "Catch Flex." Use your hand as a cursor to navigate the game's interface, eliminating the need for a traditional gamepad.

But "Catch Flex" isn't just about solo play. It's crafted to connect people. Whether it's challenging friends, having a family dance-off, or hosting a dance party, our game's dynamic setting is perfect for both individual and group fun, ensuring every session is unique and thrilling.

Prepare to unlock your inner dancer, enliven your routine, and stay active in the most delightful way. "Catch Flex" isn't just a game; it's a journey of rhythm, movement, and pure joy. Let's dance, shine, and thrive together!


Motivation

We have a deep passion for rhythm and dance games, yet we've observed that this genre often doesn't get the attention it deserves and faces numerous challenges. A significant setback has been the discontinuation of support for motion cameras by major companies. Additionally, many current games depend on less accurate accelerometer-based tracking or require the use of costly extra equipment like body trackers. Our aim is to make a meaningful change in this area, bringing a different approach to rhythm and dance games.

We aim to offer an enticing alternative — to make the tracking process simpler and more seamless, liberating dancers from the need to hold or attach bulky equipment. Thanks to the advancements in modern smartphones, we now have the technology at our fingertips. These devices are sufficiently powerful to run AI models that accurately recognize and analyze body movements, enabling precise full-body tracking.

Central to our ambition is the development of a game that not only features exact tracking but also epitomizes sheer, unfiltered fun — a game that everyone can relish and share. We are devoted to creating an experience that infuses the joy of dance into your home, designed to be as user-friendly and approachable as possible. Embark with us on this thrilling adventure of rhythm, motion, and collective delight!
